freight.name: freight_check_evidence
freight.title: freight check evidence
freight.description: Stateless NZ sea-container broker preparation from non-identifying user-reported document/fact fields. Does not establish clearance, origin, classification, authenticity or compliance.

freight.name: freight_lookup_tariff_code
freight.title: freight lookup tariff code
freight.description: Retrieve an exact user-supplied NZ ten-digit statistical item and optional check letter, effective on entryDate, from the bounded official public Customs archive. No description classification, duties or preference eligibility.

freight.name: freight_get_customs_exchange_rate
freight.title: freight get customs exchange rate
freight.description: Retrieve official Customs FX for a supplied intended lodgement entryDate. Rates are foreign currency per NZD. No market fallback or conversion. Historical dates before 2020 are out of supported range.

freight.name: freight_get_official_sources
freight.title: freight get official sources
freight.description: Return curated Customs/MPI public reference URLs; runtime guidance freshness and historical applicability are unknown.

architecture.name: prepare_rfi_register
architecture.title: prepare rfi register
architecture.description: Stateless redacted RFI coordination over supplied question/evidence mappings. Preserve all subparts and unresolved items. User-supplied page/hash provenance only; no PDF reading, source verification, code assessment or certification. Do not send private/licensed material.

architecture.name: compare_rfi_registers
architecture.title: compare rfi registers
architecture.description: Compare two supplied redacted registers and recheck reviewer decisions when evidence/document revision/hash/question dependencies change. No source-file or geometry comparison; no persistence.

architecture.name: export_rfi_matrix
architecture.title: export rfi matrix
architecture.description: Revalidate and export every question and unresolved flag as JSON or formula-safe CSV. Return content only; no storage, email or council upload. Supplied citations remain unverified.
